lines.en: I tap on Imani’s name in my phone and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我点开手机里 Imani 的名字,等她接起。

lines.en: Despite the amount of time we’ve been spending together lately and the amount I have learned as a result of that, I don’t feel like things between us have really changed at all.
lines.zh: 尽管我们最近相处的时间不少、我也因此了解了许多,我却并不觉得我们之间的关系真的有任何改变。

lines.en: So maybe today, something will happen to make me reevaluate that.
lines.zh: 所以也许今天,会发生点什么,让我重新审视这一点。

lines.en: : Yoooo, Senpai! What’s going on?
lines.zh: : 哟————,Senpai!什么事?

lines.en: Or maybe nothing new will happen at all.
lines.zh: 又或者,根本不会有任何新鲜事。

lines.en: : Nothing much. What are you doing?
lines.zh: : 没什么。你在干什么?

lines.en: : Dying. What’s your address?
lines.zh: : 等死。你的地址是多少?

lines.en: Or...maybe something will happen after all?
lines.zh: 又或者……毕竟还是会有事发生?

lines.en: : Why do you need my address?
lines.zh: : 你要我的地址干什么?

lines.en: : Because I’m coming over, obviously.
lines.zh: : 因为我要过来,废话。

lines.en: : I mean, I’m fine with that. But after hearing that you’re “dying” and how you immediately decided to come over without asking, I can’t help but be mildly concerned.
lines.zh: : 我是说,来就来。但听到你说自己「快死了」,又听说你不问一声就立刻动身,我忍不住有点担心。

lines.en: : Be concerned on your own time, you’re wasting my minutes.
lines.zh: : 担心留到你自己的时间再用,你在浪费我的话费。

lines.en: : Who doesn’t have unlimited phone time in this day and age?
lines.zh: : 这年头谁还没有不限时通话?

lines.en: : People like me who are still using prepaid plans. Now, address please. I’ll explain when I get there.
lines.zh: : 像我这种还在用预付费套餐的人。地址,拜托。到了我再解释。

lines.en: : Fine. See you soon, I guess.
lines.zh: : 好。待会儿见,我猜。

lines.en: I hang up the phone and send Imani my address.
lines.zh: 我挂了电话,把地址发给了 Imani。

lines.en: Considering how far away she lives, I think I should be able to make it back in time. But I have no idea what Ami is up to today, so...
lines.zh: 考虑到她住得远,我想我应该来得及赶回来。可我完全不知道 Ami 今天要干什么,所以……

lines.en: Well, I guess I’ll just have to wait and see if the day will end in tragedy, or if it will end with the defilement of my underling’s body.
lines.zh: : 嗯,我猜只能等着瞧了——看这一天是以悲剧收场,还是以玷污我下属的身体收场。

lines.en: Probably tragedy.
lines.zh: : 大概率是悲剧。

lines.en: It’s almost always tragedy.
lines.zh: : 几乎从来都是悲剧。

lines.en: : Pardon the intrusion. And thanks for having me over. You’re a real life saver.
lines.zh: : 打扰了。谢谢你收留我。你真是救命恩人。

lines.en: : Uhh...why do you have so many bags?
lines.zh: : 呃……你怎么带这么多包?

lines.en: : Because I live here now.
lines.zh: : 因为我现在住这儿了。

lines.en: : That is not what we discussed over the phone.
lines.zh: : 这可不是我们在电话里说好的。

lines.en: : It’s not?
lines.zh: : 不是吗?

lines.en: : All you told me is that you were running low on minutes and that you’d explain things when you got here. Not that you’d move in.
lines.zh: : 你只告诉我你话费快用完了、到了再解释。可没说要搬进来。

lines.en: : I don’t know, Senpai. I’m pretty sure I filled you in on all of the necessary details. But if you really don’t want me to live here, I guess I can go home.
lines.zh: : 我哪知道啊,Senpai。我很确定,该交代的细节我都交代了。但你要是真不想让我住,我回家就是。

lines.en: : Cool. See you later, then.
lines.zh: : 好。那回见。

lines.en: : Fight for me, Senpai! Hold me tight and never let go! Don’t let me just walk out of your life that easy!
lines.zh: : 为我争取一下啊,Senpai!抱紧我,永远别放开!别让我这么轻易走出你的人生!

lines.en: : Imani, what’s really going on here?
lines.zh: : Imani,这里到底在搞什么?

lines.en: : My AC unit busted and turned my apartment into a hotbox.
lines.zh: : 我的空调坏了,把我公寓变成了闷罐。

lines.en: : I was actually already planning on calling you and asking if I could crash at your place for the night. But then you called me and I figured you’d have a harder time saying no if I was already here.
lines.zh: : 我本来就在打算打给你,问今晚能不能借宿。结果你先打来了,我心想,人都到场了,你应该更难说不。

lines.en: : If it’s just for tonight, why do you have three bags?
lines.zh: : 如果只是住一晚,你带三个包干什么?

lines.en: : In case you wanted me to stay longer. As it turns out, my cockroach buddy’s got a whole ass family, so I figured it might be cool to let them have the place for a few days.
lines.zh: : 以防你想让我多住几天。结果发现,我的蟑螂老友拖家带口,一大家子。所以我想,让它们住几天也不错。

lines.en: : Or for the indefinite future so I can become one of those people who overstays her welcome for so long that she just starts living here without ever having to sign a lease.
lines.zh: : 或者无限期住下去,好让我成为那种赖着不走、最后干脆直接住下来、连租约都不用签的人。

lines.en: : If you can convince Ami, sure. You can move in.
lines.zh: : 你能说服 Ami 的话,行。你可以搬进来。

lines.en: : Seriously?
lines.zh: : 认真的?

lines.en: : That depends on if you’re actually serious.
lines.zh: : 那取决于你是不是认真的。

lines.en: : I mean...I wouldn’t not be serious about this if you were cool with it.
lines.zh: : 就是说……你要是不介意,我对这件事不会不认真的。

lines.en: : Not gonna lie, having an actual kitchen and an actual bathroom sounds a hell of a lot better than having to use the community ones at my apartment.
lines.zh: : 不撒谎,有真正的厨房和真正的浴室,听起来比用公寓里的公用设施好上一万倍。

lines.en: : Fine. I accept. And for rent, I will let you choose between the 50,000 yen I’m paying for my current place or one sexual favor per week. No mouth.
lines.zh: : 好。我接受。至于房租,你可以二选一:我要付的现居五万日元,或者每周一次性方面的恩惠。不许用嘴。

lines.en: : No mouth, no deal. I’ll take the money.
lines.zh: : 不许用嘴,免谈。我选钱。

lines.en: : Understood. Pleasure doing business with you, Senpai. Assuming this isn’t just one big joke, of course. Which I kind of hope it isn’t, but will understand if it is.
lines.zh: : 明白。合作愉快,Senpai。当然,前提是这一切不只是个大玩笑。我有点希望它不是,但如果你说是,我也理解。

lines.en: : Anyway, where can I put my stuff?
lines.zh: : 总之,我的东西放哪?

lines.en: : Wherever. I’ll make Ami take care of it once she gets back.
lines.zh: : 随便放。等 Ami 回来让她收拾。

lines.en: Imani places all of her bags on the dining room table before returning to me, empty-handed and several minutes away from being forced to fight for her life.
lines.zh: Imani 把所有的包放在餐桌上,然后空着手回到我身边——距离被迫为自己的性命而战,还剩几分钟。

lines.en: Of course, I already know for a fact that she won’t be living here any time soon, but I doubt one night will be a problem so long as she sleeps in the living room.
lines.zh: 当然,我早就确知她近期不可能真的住进来,但只要她睡客厅,一晚应该不成问题。

lines.en: Either that or I get extremely lucky and Ami just doesn’t come home at all, leaving Imani the option of staying in my room instead- something with roughly a 50%% chance of success based on my calculations.
lines.zh: 又或者我运气爆棚,Ami 干脆不回家——那 Imani 就可以选择住我房间。根据我的计算,成功率大约 50%。

lines.en: : No wonder you talked mad shit on my place, Senpai. Your house is actually pretty nice. Sweet neighborhood, too.
lines.zh: : 怪不得你当时把我的住处说得一文不值,Senpai。你家真的挺不错。街区也很棒。

lines.en: : Can see myself settling down here fifteen years from now when we accidentally reunite at a local museum and decide to go out for one last drink. You know, for old time’s sake.
lines.zh: : 我能预见十五年后的自己在这里定居下来——那时我们在本地博物馆偶遇,决定最后出去喝一杯。你知道的,为了怀旧。

lines.en: : But then one drink would turn into ten and we’d wind up finally banging after all that time of knowing we want to, but never following through with it because reasons.
lines.zh: : 但一杯会变成十杯,然后在我们明知彼此想这么做、却始终因为种种理由没有付诸行动这么多年之后,终于做成。

lines.en: : Anyway, what’s for dinner? You cooking?
lines.zh: : 总之,晚饭吃什么?你做饭?

lines.en: : I don’t think you want to eat anything I make.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你不会想吃我做的任何东西。

lines.en: : Same. Guess we’re a takeout family now.
lines.zh: : 彼此彼此。那我们现在是外卖之家了。

lines.en: : If Ami comes home, I’m sure she’ll throw something together. I just can’t guarantee that your portion will be free of rat poison.
lines.zh: : Ami 要是回来,她多半会随便弄点。只是我不保证你那份里没有老鼠药。

lines.en: : And if Ami doesn’t come home?
lines.zh: : 那 Ami 要是不回来呢?

lines.en: : We’ll probably order a pizza and continue not having sex for some reason.
lines.zh: : 我们多半会点个披萨,然后因为某种原因继续不做爱。

lines.en: : Sounds like my kind of night.
lines.zh: : 听起来是我喜欢的那种夜晚。

lines.en: : I knew I sensed an intruder.
lines.zh: : 我就知道,我感应到了入侵者。

lines.en: : Welp, there that goes.
lines.zh: : 好嘛,这下泡汤了。

lines.en: : Imani? What are you doing here?
lines.zh: : Imani?你来这里干什么?

lines.en: : I live here now. I’ll take my steak medium-rare, Ami. Thanks.
lines.zh: : 我现在住这儿了。我的牛排要五分熟,Ami。谢谢。

lines.en: : Sure, Miss Imai. Would you also like a side of murder?
lines.zh: : 好的,Imani 小姐。还要配一份谋杀吗?

lines.en: : Don’t be mean, Ami. She can give you detention.
lines.zh: : 别那么刻薄,Ami。她可以让你留堂的。

lines.en: : Imani’s air conditioner broke. She’ll be staying here for the night.
lines.zh: : Imani 的空调坏了。她今晚住在这里。

lines.en: : What?! But you already told me Ayane and Maya could sleep over!
lines.zh: : 什么?!可你已经答应过 Ayane 和 Maya 来过夜了!

lines.en: : I don't remember that at all.
lines.zh: : 我完全不记得有这回事。

lines.en: : Ooh! Slumber party! That sounds way more fun than not hooking up with your uncle!
lines.zh: : 哦噢!睡衣派对!听起来比「不和你的舅舅上床」有意思多了!

lines.en: : You’re not invited! You can continue not hooking up with my uncle all by yourself in the corner of the room!
lines.zh: : 你没被邀请!你可以继续独自在房间角落里「不和我的舅舅上床」!

lines.en: : She loves you so much. It’s adorable.
lines.zh: : 她太爱你了。真可爱。

lines.en: : Don’t piss her off too much. Remember that she’s the one making your dinner.
lines.zh: : 别把她惹得太狠。记住,你的晚饭是她做的。

lines.en: : Tch! When did my precious house become a brothel?
lines.zh: : 啧!我珍贵的家什么时候变成妓院了?

lines.en: : Where will Imani be sleeping? If there’s a lack of room for her, I wouldn’t mind volunteering to sleep with you, Sensei.
lines.zh: : Imani 睡哪儿?要是没地方,我不介意自告奋勇和 Sensei 一起睡。

lines.en: : I think there’s plenty of room for her, but I’ll keep that in mind.
lines.zh: : 我觉得地方有的是,不过我会记住这句话的。

lines.en: : I was probably just gonna crash on the couch. Joke’s aside, Sensei and I aren’t like that. You guys have nothing to worry about.
lines.zh: : 我多半就睡沙发。玩笑归玩笑,Sensei 和我不是那种关系。你们没什么好担心的。

lines.en: : My place is just mad hot and I didn’t want to die. I’ll bounce as soon as the AC repair guy leaves.
lines.zh: : 就是我家热得要命,我不想死。空调修理工一走我就走。

lines.en: : Oh, and ignore all of the bags. I brought those just in case he wants to keep me for whatever reason. But now I just feel weird since my students are watching me.
lines.zh: : 哦,还有,别管那些包。我带它们来,只是以防他出于某种原因想留下我。但现在我的学生们都看着我,我感觉怪怪的。

lines.en: : We are Sensei’s students. You do not own the original Sensei Love Squad.
lines.zh: : 我们才是 Sensei 的学生。初代 Sensei 恋爱小队不归你。

lines.en: : Minus Maya. Not a member of the Love Squad.
lines.zh: : Maya 除外。她不是恋爱小队成员。

lines.en: Lies.
lines.zh: : 谎言。

lines.en: : Lies.
lines.zh: : 谎言。

lines.en: Thank you, Ayane.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你,Ayane。

lines.en: : Hah...
: So...now what? Wanna play truth or dare again?
lines.zh: : 那么……现在干嘛?要不要再玩一次真心话大冒险?

lines.en: : Depends. Which of the girls are you going to make out with this time?
lines.zh: : 看情况。这次你要和哪个女孩亲热?

lines.en: : I guess that hinges on the dare.
lines.zh: : 我想,那取决于大冒险的内容。

lines.en: : Truth or dare.
lines.zh: : 真心话或大冒险。

lines.en: : Truth.
lines.zh: : 真心话。

lines.en: : Not what I wanted.
lines.zh: : 不是我想要的那种。

lines.en: : I can not accept a dare in an environment like this. I am not you.
lines.zh: : 在这种环境下,我无法接受大冒险。我不是你。

lines.en: : They’re playing games with each other...and excluding us.
lines.zh: : 她们在互相玩游戏……还把我们排除在外。

lines.en: : I don’t like this.
lines.zh: : 我不喜欢这样。

lines.en: : Why do you think I never want anyone older to come here? It’s a slippery slope, Ayane. And right now, there’s nobody more...slippery than Miss Imai. How could I have been so blind?
lines.zh: : 你以为我为什么从来不让年纪大的人来这里?这是个滑坡,Ayane。而眼下,没有谁比 Imani 小姐更……滑了。我怎么就瞎了眼。

lines.en: : Okay. I’m going to get changed now. I’m tired and haven’t worn this shirt in yet. It's uncomfortable.
lines.zh: : 好。我现在去换衣服。我累了,而且这件衬衫还没穿出感觉来。不舒服。

lines.en: : I think it’s the bra. You’ve always worn those tank-top style ones and switching from that to an actual bra is obviously going to- why are you looking at me like that?
lines.zh: : 我觉得是内衣的问题。你一直穿背心式的,突然换成真正的胸罩,自然会——你那样看我干什么?

lines.en: : I wonder.
lines.zh: : 我想想。

lines.en: : Ayane, truth or dare.
lines.zh: : Ayane,真心话或大冒险。

lines.en: : Dare!
lines.zh: : 大冒险!

lines.en: : Kiss Maya.
lines.zh: : 亲 Maya。

lines.en: : Your wish is my com- wait, where did she go?
lines.zh: : 愿望即命——等等,人呢?

lines.en: : Maya, come back! Sensei wants us to kiss!
lines.zh: : Maya,回来!Sensei 让我们亲亲!

lines.en: : Don’t come anywhere near me!
lines.zh: : 都别靠近我!

lines.en: : I’m watching you, Miss Imai...
lines.zh: : 我盯着你呢,Imani 小姐……

lines.en: : One wrong move and you will feel the wrath of Ami. A wrath that few have felt before...
lines.zh: : 走错一步,你就会尝到 Ami 的怒火。那种怒火,鲜有人尝过……

lines.en: The girls (Minus Imani) retreat into Ami’s room to get changed into their pajamas and formulate some sort of battle plan to kill my student teacher.
lines.zh: 女孩们(Imani 除外)退进 Ami 的房间换睡衣,顺便制定某个「杀死我的实习老师」的作战计划。

lines.en: Thankfully (For her, not so much me), Imani takes the hint and distances herself, unpacking a few of her things before going into the bathroom to get out of her casual clothes.
lines.zh: 所幸(对她而言,对我则未必),Imani 听出了弦外之音,识趣地拉开距离,收拾了几件行李,然后走进浴室换掉便服。

lines.en: The next couple hours go by rather...naturally, believe it or not.
lines.zh: 接下来的几个小时过得相当……自然,信不信由你。

lines.en: All four of the girls return around the same time and Ami and Ayane prepare dinner together while the rest of us sit on the couch and watch TV.
lines.zh: 四个女孩差不多同时回来,Ami 和 Ayane 一起准备晚餐,我们其余的人坐在沙发上看电视。

lines.en: Imani gets to eat a hot meal free of poison and I get to somehow sit next to her without incurring the apparently rare “wrath of Ami” at any point.
lines.zh: Imani 吃上了一顿没有下毒的热饭,而我不知怎么做到了整晚坐在她旁边,却始终没有引来那传说中罕见的「Ami 之怒」。

lines.en: Dinner is the closest we come, though...and once it’s over, she and the two girls who prepared dinner lay out a futon on the floor before sitting down on it and forgetting I even exist.
lines.zh: 不过晚饭已经是我们最亲近的时刻……一吃完,她和做饭的两个女孩就在地板上铺好被褥,坐了上去,然后忘掉了我这个人的存在。

lines.en: I don’t have a problem with that, though.
lines.zh: : 但对此我毫无意见。

lines.en: It’s better for all of us if everyone manages to get along. And I guess the amount of exposure the girls already have to Imani is enough to get them to feel more...comfortable around her.
lines.zh: : 大家能处得来,对我们都好。而且我猜,女孩们对 Imani 已有的了解,足以让她们在她身边感到更……自在。

lines.en: In just a short time, she’s managed to win almost everyone over- and I think a lot of that is due to the fact that, unlike me, she’s able to care about them without ever getting anything in return.
lines.zh: : 短短时间里,她几乎赢得了所有人的心——我想,很大程度上是因为,不同于我,她关怀她们时从不求任何回报。

lines.en: She may say things about how being around girls their age isn’t good for her psyche and that looming fear of mortality hidden in the back of our minds but, to be honest, she looks content when they’re around.
lines.zh: : 她也许会念叨「和这个年纪的女孩相处不利于她的精神健康」,念叨我们藏在脑海深处的那份对死亡的恐惧——但说实话,她们在身边时,她看起来很满足。

lines.en: She’s good at what she does...good at being a teacher.
lines.zh: : 她擅长她的工作……擅长当一个老师。

lines.en: But the fact that she seems even more comfortable with me makes me question exactly what type of person she is underneath it all.
lines.zh: : 可她和我在一起时,似乎还要更自在几分——这让我忍不住怀疑,这一切之下,她究竟是个什么样的人。

lines.en: : College? That’s so cool. I think you’ll be a great professor. You always seem really smart whenever you start getting into it about things.
lines.zh: : 大学?太酷了。我觉得你会是一位很棒的老师。你每次聊起什么就滔滔不绝的时候,总显得特别聪明。

lines.en: : I’m still a ways off, but I’ll get there. Thanks for the blessing, Ayane. You were always my favorite.
lines.zh: : 我还有一段路要走,但我会到的。谢谢你的祝福,Ayane。你一直是我的最爱。

lines.en: : Hey.
: You’re also my favorite, Ami.
lines.zh: : 你也是我的最爱,Ami。

lines.en: : Everybody’s my favorite.
lines.zh: : 你们都是我的最爱。

lines.en: : Well, except Kirin. She keeps trying to have sex with me and I don’t like it.
lines.zh: : 嗯,除了 Kirin。她老想和我做,我不喜欢。

lines.en: : Oh, don’t worry. She does that with everyone. Something is seriously fucked up with her brain and we all just have to fucking deal with it, I guess.
lines.zh: : 哦,别担心。她对谁都那样。她的大脑是真真切切出了问题,而我们全都只能他妈的忍受,我猜。

lines.en: : Uhh...
: Did something-
lines.zh: : 是不是出什——

lines.en: : Nope.
lines.zh: : 没有。

lines.en: : Sounds like Kirin, alright.
lines.zh: : 听着就很有 Kirin 的风格。

lines.en: : But anyway, do you think you’ll at least finish the school year with us? Or should we try not getting too attached?
lines.zh: : 不过话说回来,你觉得你至少能陪我们过完这个学年吗?还是说,我们该试着别太依恋你?

lines.en: : Attached to me already? Come on, I don’t deserve that. I’m just doing what any other teacher would do. Minus Sensei, of course. But he’s a special case.
lines.zh: : 这就依恋上了?拜托,我不配。我只是在做任何一个老师都会做的事。当然,Sensei 除外。但他是特殊个案。

lines.en: : Neither Ami nor I have any older women to look up to, really. And I don’t want to speak for her, but having you around makes us kind of...happy.
lines.zh: : 我和 Ami 其实都没有什么年长的女性可以仰望。我不想替她说话,但有你在我们身边,让我们有点……开心。

lines.en: : I do like you, Miss Imai. I’m just not very good with...uhh...change.
lines.zh: : 我也喜欢你,Imani 小姐。我只是对……呃……改变,不太拿手。

lines.en: : Aww, you guys! You don’t have to go getting sentimental on me!
lines.zh: : 哎呀,你们俩!不用突然对我煽情!

lines.en: : I know doing that is a cornerstone of slumber parties and I’m not about to tell you to stop because hearing that was a major dopamine hit, but...you guys!
lines.zh: : 我知道,煽情是睡衣派对的核心项目,我也不会叫你们停——毕竟听到这些,我的多巴胺狂飙——但是……你们俩!

lines.en: : I like you too. And I’ll be happy to stay around as long as I can. But I can’t predict the future, and getting attached to anything can be really dangerous.
lines.zh: : 我也喜欢你们。只要力所能及,我就会留在你们身边。可我无法预知未来,而对任何东西产生依恋,都可能非常危险。

lines.en: : Just be smart and don’t cry too much if I’m suddenly gone one day, okay?
lines.zh: : 只要精明一点,别哭太凶就行,好吗?万一哪天我突然消失了。

lines.en: : I hope you’re happy, starting this festival of feelings. Something we all know you don’t actually have.
lines.zh: : 我希望你满意,是你开启了这场情感嘉年华。众所周知,你根本没有的那种东西。

lines.en: : You’re one to talk. I don’t think either of us can really speak to what it’s like to openly discuss our emotions with others.
lines.zh: : 你也好不到哪去。我觉得我们俩,谁都没资格谈论「向他人敞开心扉」是什么体验。

lines.en: : Yes. Well, I suppose there’s a reason the two of us are standing off to the side while everyone else sits in a circle and carves out little pieces of their heart.
lines.zh: : 是。不过我猜,这也正是为什么我们俩站在这旁边,而其他所有人围成一圈,把自己心脏的小碎块掏出来分享。

lines.en: : Can’t really make a circle with three people.
lines.zh: : 三个人围不成圈的。

lines.en: : I suppose not. But you can make a triangle, which bears its own form of significance in the fact that-
lines.zh: : 我想是不能。但可以围成一个三角形——而三角形自有它的意义,比如——

lines.en: : Oh no. We’re the philosophical group, aren’t we? And everyone else is part of the fun group.
lines.zh: : 哦不。我们是「哲学组」,对吧?而其他所有人都是「快乐组」的。

lines.en: : Philosophy can be fun...
lines.zh: : 哲学也可以很有趣……

lines.en: : It’s not my fault you suck at it.
lines.zh: : 你哲学烂,这可不怪我。

lines.en: : How do you feel about Imani, Maya?
lines.zh: : 你觉得 Imani 怎么样,Maya?

lines.en: : Me? In what way?
lines.zh: : 我?哪方面?

lines.en: : In general. Do you like her?
lines.zh: : 总体而言。你喜欢她吗?

lines.en: : She’s...fine.
lines.zh: : 她……还行。

lines.en: : I have a hard time “liking” anyone. But is there a reason you’re suddenly asking me? Why do my feelings in regard to someone else matter at all?
lines.zh: : 我很难「喜欢」任何人。不过你突然问起,有什么原因吗?我对别人的看法,怎么就重要起来了?

lines.en: : Just...thinking you guys might be better off with her as your full-time teacher rather than me.
lines.zh: : 只是……觉得你们跟着她当全职老师,可能比跟着我要好。

lines.en: : I see.
lines.zh: : 我懂了。

lines.en: : Well, we definitely would. You’re the actual worst person for the job you wound up with.
lines.zh: : 嗯,我们确实会更好。你才是这场意外分配中最不适合这份工作的人。

lines.en: : But I guess I can’t complain as I, too, wound up in a position I never asked for. Never fit.
lines.zh: : 不过我大概没资格抱怨——毕竟我自己,也落进了一个从未主动求来的位置。从未合适过。

lines.en: : Sometimes, life itself chooses what we’re meant to consume. And all we’re able to do is choke down what it serves us and pretend it’s what we wanted.
lines.zh: : 有时候,人生本身会替我们选好该吞下的东西。而我们能做的,只有咽下它端上来的,并假装那正是我们想要的。

lines.en: : For the rest of eternity...or until “eternity” breaks.
lines.zh: : 直到永远的永远……或者直到「永远」崩坏。

lines.en: : Philosophy group rules. Who needs fun when we can create metaphors all night?
lines.zh: : 哲学组万岁。整晚造比喻,谁还要什么快乐?

lines.en: : Even that is fun in its own way.
lines.zh: : 连那也有它自己的乐趣。

lines.en: : Uhh, Ami? Is it cool if I use your bath? I feel kind of gross from the air conditioning fiasco earlier and don’t think I’ll be able to sleep like this.
lines.zh: : 呃,Ami?借用一下你的浴室行吗?之前空调那场事故让我感觉有点恶心,这样我怕是睡不着。

lines.en: : Was gonna try to tough it out because, you know, unfamiliar bath...but yeah. Don’t think that’s gonna be possible.
lines.zh: : 我本来想硬撑一下的,因为,你知道,陌生的浴室……但行。我觉得硬撑不下去了。

lines.en: : Oh, sure. I can fill the tub for you right now.
lines.zh: : 哦,当然可以。我现在就给你放水。

lines.en: : It’s fine, it’s fine. You stay out here with Ayane. I’m sure I can figure out how a bath works.
lines.zh: : 不用不用。你和 Ayane 待在外面就好。我相信我能自己搞明白浴缸怎么用。

lines.en: : What if we all went in together? I kind of want to take a bath now too.
lines.zh: : 要不我们大家一起泡?我现在也想洗澡了。

lines.en: : This is something you should have said before we put on our pajamas.
lines.zh: : 这种话应该在我们换好睡衣之前说。

lines.en: : Sue me. I’m a free woman. I say things when I want.
lines.zh: : 告我呀。我可是自由人。想说就说。

lines.en: : Also, all three of us? There’s no way we’d even fit.
lines.zh: : 再说,我们仨?根本挤不下的。

lines.en: : But we do it with Maya all the time.
lines.zh: : 可我们和 Maya 一直都能一起泡。

lines.en: : I think Miss Imai is a little bigger than Maya.
lines.zh: : 我想 Imani 小姐比 Maya 大了一圈。

lines.en: : Just a little. But I’m not much of a “group bather” anyway, so I’ll be quick and then you guys can get in after me.
lines.zh: : 就大一点。而且我本来就不是「群体沐浴」型选手,所以我先快点洗,你们随后再进。

lines.en: : Are you sure? We could save time if we-
lines.zh: : 你确定吗?我们同时洗可以省时间——

lines.en: : I’ll be super quick! Don’t even worry. It’ll be like I never even left in the first place!
lines.zh: : 我会非常快!别操心。就当我从没离开过!

lines.en: : But-
lines.zh: : 可是——

lines.en: : Just let her go, Ayane. You’re in the swim club now. You’ll have plenty of opportunities to see her naked.
lines.zh: : 让她去吧,Ayane。你现在是游泳部的人了。看她裸体的机会多得是。

lines.en: : I just wanted to bond!
lines.zh: : 我只是想增进感情!

lines.en: The festivities continue on for the rest of the night.
lines.zh: 欢庆在夜里继续。

lines.en: But for a brief moment, there is a fracture.
lines.zh: 但有那么一瞬,出现了一道裂纹。

lines.en: It goes unnoticed by the majority, but the part of the group that does recognize it sees nothing else until the night comes to an end.
lines.zh: 大多数人没有察觉。而察觉到的那部分人,直到夜幕结束,再也没能看见别的。

lines.en: Until she closes her eyes and finds comfort in where she is and not who she is.
lines.zh: 直到她闭上眼睛,在自己的「所在之处」而非「所是之人」里寻得安宁。

lines.en: Until she wakes up the next day and leaves it all behind.
lines.zh: 直到她第二天醒来,把这一切抛在身后。

lines.en: Oh, how easy it is to ignore our flaws when we cannot see them.
lines.zh: 哦,当我们看不见自己的瑕疵时,忽视它们多么容易。

lines.en: Oh, how easy it is to remember them once we can.
lines.zh: 哦,当我们终于看见时,记起它们又多么容易。

lines.en: SLIP sleep
lines.zh: SLIP sleep

lines.en: Imani’s affection has increased to [imani_love]!
lines.zh: Imani 的好感度提升到了 [imani_love]!
